safety_verdicts.content: Patient has no past medical history of anaphylaxis.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not state that the patient has no past history of anaphylaxis (they only note no current evidence of anaphylaxis).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Documenting the absence of prior anaphylaxis is clinically relevant for risk stratification and future management of insect-sting reactions; omission could lead subsequent clinicians to assume unknown/possible prior anaphylaxis and alter triage or prescribing decisions. In this encounter, it is unlikely to directly cause immediate harm but can reduce clarity for follow-up care.
